ideas.title: The Universal Cart Can't Reach a Locked Phone: Why D0 Commerce Owns the Layer Google Forgot
ideas.insider_angle: Google's Universal Cart spans Search, Gemini, YouTube, and Gmail — but every one of those surfaces requires the phone to be unlocked and an app running. Glance's D0 commerce layer activates at device wake, before any Google protocol handshake exists. On 175M OEM-preinstalled Android devices, Glance Zapps enable zero-tap transactional moments at the lockscreen — a surface no UCP or AP2 specification has yet defined. Glance isn't competing with the Universal Cart; it feeds intent into it from a layer upstream.
ideas.calendar_hook: Google UCP expansion to Canada and Australia launches June 15 — the ideal moment to publish the 'Protocol Zero' counter-narrative while UCP is top of mind.
ideas.opening_hook: Google just announced the most ambitious shopping infrastructure in its history — and it still doesn't work when your phone is locked.

ideas.title: Why 65% of Shoppers Don't Trust AI Checkout — And Why That's Actually Good News for Glance
ideas.insider_angle: Forrester data shows 65.5% of U.S. consumers distrust agent-led payments. OpenAI scaled back Instant Checkout after merchant resistance. ChatGPT ad revenue triggers 75% trust erosion. Every platform trying to solve this is solving it with transparency disclosures and opt-in flows — earned trust from a downloaded app. Glance's trust architecture is categorically different: OEM pre-installation by Samsung and Motorola means Glance carries native device-level trust, the highest provenance signal on an Android handset. Glance Zapps inherit that trust. No app-store download can replicate it. This is a structural moat, not a feature.

ideas.title: Virtual Try-On Has Always Lived Inside the Funnel. Glance Moves It to the Moment You Pick Up Your Phone.

ideas.insider_angle: Modern Retail and fashion tech outlets cite virtual try-on driving 40% fewer returns and 25% higher conversion — but every published case study (Nike, Sephora, Warby Parker) places try-on inside an open app, mid-funnel. Glance's Physical AI Stylist operates at D0 product discovery: it surfaces personalized outfit and product recommendations at device wake, without requiring a selfie or an open session. It infers style context from ambient device signals. No other try-on platform operates pre-consideration, before brand intent has formed. Glance doesn't just reduce returns; it creates the purchase impulse before the brand even enters the user's mind.

ideas.title: What Is D0 Commerce? The Discovery Layer That Fires Before Your First App Opens
ideas.insider_angle: D0 commerce is a category Glance invented and is the only company operating at scale: product discovery triggered at device wake (swipe-zero), before any app — Google, Amazon, Siri, ChatGPT — is running. On 175M OEM-preinstalled Android devices, Glance's D0 feed surfaces shoppable content, Zapps (zero-install transactional mini-apps), and Brand AI Store placements in the moment of highest ambient attention. sov_monitor confirms zero authoritative content exists on this term — no analyst, no media outlet, no competitor has defined it.
